newsitem.title: FRANCE: Medical charity leaves Chechnya after killings.
newsitem.headline: Medical charity leaves Chechnya after killings.

text.p: The medical charity Medecins du Monde (World Doctors) said on Tuesday it had pulled out of Chechnya and would not return until the January 27 presidential elections because of the killing of six Red Cross workers.
The Paris-based charity voiced shock at the deaths of the Red Cross workers. It said in a statement its team had already left Grozny three days ago because of deteriorating security.
"As a sign of solidarity towards the ICRC, MdM has decided to stay out until January 27," it said.
A spokesman for another international medical charity, Medecins sans Frontieres, said it was considering the situation and had yet to make a decision on whether to pull out.
The aid workers, five of them women, were shot dead as they slept in a Chechen village on Tuesday.
